subject: Org gate warmstart — invites, API keys, and admin roles
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@octave.health>, Tim O'Neal <tim.oneal@octave.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Org gate warmstart — invites, API keys, and admin roles

Hi Sarah & Tim,

Thanks again for signing the SOW — excited to get Octave Health live. This thread is to lock down the initial tenant / org setup so our implementation sprint can start next Monday.

Concrete asks from our side to finish before we hand off to Engineering: 
- Confirm 2 initial workspace admins (names + emails). These users will receive invites and be seeded with org-admin role.
- A short list of 3 scopes you want enabled initially (examples: embeddings, chat-generation, file-ingest).
- Where you will host audit logs (if you want logs forwarded to your S3/Cloud Storage).

What we'll do once those items are confirmed:
1) Create the tenant in the prod control plane and seed two admin accounts.
2) Generate a scoped service API key for backend ingestion and a separate key for client-side calls (rotatable).
3) Share the tenant onboarding checklist and RSA thumbprint for your security team.

I've copied Monica (CS Implementation) who will run the invites and technical handoff. Monica — can you provision the workspace and attach the initial checklist here when ready?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: tenant-onboard-checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)]

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@octave.health>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Tim O'Neal <tim.oneal@octave.health>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Org gate warmstart — invites, API keys, and admin roles

Jordan — thanks. Confirming the two admins:
- Sarah Lin (sarah.lin@octave.health) — Security lead
- Tim O'Neal (tim.oneal@octave.health) — Platform lead

Initial scopes: embeddings, chat-generation, and file-ingest (PDFs).
We want audit logs delivered to our S3 bucket (s3://octave-security-logs/redwood). I'll loop in our infra team if you need IAM details.

Can you also provide an estimated ETA for the seeded API keys and a short note on rotation cadence?

— Sarah
Director, Security & Compliance
Octave Health

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Org gate warmstart — invites, API keys, and admin roles

Thanks for the confirmation, Sarah. Plan and next steps below — I've attached the checklist and the RSA thumbprint for your security team.

What I'll provision today (ETA: 3–4 hours):
- Tenant: octave-prod (control-plane id: OCT-8721)
- Seeded admins: sarah.lin@octave.health, tim.oneal@octave.health (invites sent)
- Service keys: 
  * backend-ingest key — scoped to file-ingest + embeddings, expires in 365 days (rotatable)
  * client-public key — limited to chat-generation, rate-limited by IP (short-lived, rotate 30d)

Key delivery method: We'll upload a secure key bundle to the Redwoods secure artifact link and confirm via DM. After you confirm receipt, we recommend rotating the client-public key on day 30.

Deferred item requiring Octave infra input: S3 bucket write access. We need either an IAM role ARN we can assume (preferred) or temporary credentials to validate log delivery. If you'd rather we push logs to Splunk/Datadog, tell us the forwarder endpoint.

Attachment notes:
- tenant-onboard-checklist.xlsx — checklist for admins (invite flow, role descriptions, sign-off steps).
- octave-rsa-thumbprint.pdf — RSA thumbprint for control-plane TLS cert (give to security).

Action items:
- Sarah: confirm IAM role ARN (or grant small write test creds) for s3://octave-security-logs/redwood
- Tim: confirm if you want client-public key IP restrictions (list of allowed CIDRs)

I'll post the invite links here once the invites are generated.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager — Implementation
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: octave-rsa-thumbprint.pdf (pdf, 12KB)]

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@octave.health>

Monica — appreciate the fast turnaround. We will: 
- Provide an IAM role ARN by end of day (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/octave-redwood-logs)
- Tim will follow up with allowed CIDRs for the client-public key (should be 54.210.0.0/16 and our office ranges)

Please go ahead with seeding the tenant and sending invites — we'll confirm sign-in and report back.

Sarah Lin
Director, Security & Compliance
Octave Health
